$comment: Key rules as data (spec/conformance.md section 3, spec 7.4). A case names one ('key': "rasl"); the driver sends its rules in 'render' and 'diff' requests, and the adapter builds the binding's key rule from them. For a directive, the first rule whose 'directive' is its name, and whose 'parent' (when given) is its parent's name, gives the key: ["value", i] is its i-th value's text (absent when it has fewer values); ["join", sep] is every value's text joined by sep (empty text when it has none). No rule matches: absent.
